skill_name: Create a script for a news report about the effect of the coronavirus on the education system.
workflow: Good evening, this is John Smith with a news report on the effect of the coronavirus on the education system. As the coronavirus pandemic continues to spread around the world, educational institutions have been forced to shift to virtual instruction. Schools, colleges, and universities have been closed and millions have had to rely on online learning. Experts are concerned that this shift could result in widening educational gaps and potentially have long-term implications on student achievement
